begin

 :ctrl_blk_1.cust_id != 'STANDARD')
 then

 temp_include, False, temp_id);

 end if;
 end if;

 check_package_failure;
 go_query('contacts');
end;

Item.Name: EFF_DATE
Item.Hint: Enter effective date as DD-MON-YYYY format.

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
 v_local_date date;
begin
 nullchk;
 --
 -- Check that effective date is >= today
 --
 IF is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 v_local_date := v_local_time;
 else
 v_local_date := sysdate;
 end if;
 
 if :system.record_status in ('NEW','INSERT','CHANGED')
 then
 if trunc(:eff_date) < trunc(v_local_date)
 then
 show_error_dist ('0501');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :term_date < :eff_date and
 :term_date is not null
 then
 next_item;
 show_error_dist ('4503');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_RECORD
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure validate_record is
/* make sure all of the not null fields in the contracts table
 are not null before committing the record. */
begin
 /*NOTE: Error code 0201 is 'All required fields must be entered' */
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if :contacts.last_name is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('contacts.last_name');
 show_error_dist('0201');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif :contacts.first_name is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('contacts.first_name');
 show_error_dist('0201');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif :contacts.contact_type is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('contacts.contact_type');
 show_error_dist('0201');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif :contacts.day_phone_no is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('contacts.day_phone_no');
 show_error_dist('0201');
 check_package_failure;
 elsif :contacts.eff_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('contacts.eff_date');
 show_error_dist('0201');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_CHARACTER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure validate_character(temp_char in VARCHAR2)
is
begin
 if (ltrim(upper(temp_char),' ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ.')) is null
 then
 null;
 else
 show_error_dist('0352'); -- Value must be an alpha character
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;
